card.title: I Survived This First
card.instruction: Use your experience with hardship as emotional seniority, offering guidance and judging how well others are handling the pressure.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your first restaurant review? When mine came, I made tea before opening it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've opened it. Two stars. I'm ringing the critic.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's the stage where I unplugged my phone. Milk?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then let it ring while the tea brews. You're rushing a mistake I took all afternoon over.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 makes A's review experience the model, A3 identifies B's phone impulse as a known stage, and A5 judges its speed against A's earlier mistake.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's two-star result and critic call inform A3's unplugging advice; B4's already-dialled call causes A5's brewing-time delay.

relationship.evidence: B2 is responding to a concrete bad review and B4 explains that advice now arrives after dialing.

heightening.evidence: A5 uses B4's live ringing stage to impose A's slower coping timetable.
